output.reason: [ev-69b054a33ac2] says the Helm options `proxy.prometheus.enabled` and `proxy.prometheus.port` have been removed and tells users to switch to `envoy.prometheus.*`. Values set under a removed key are no longer honoured, so setting-ignored (mandatory work) is the right kind. The validators confirm the keys are gone from the target values [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5]. The proposed statement is wrong in two ways: it leaves out `proxy.prometheus.port`, and it claims monitoring "will not be enabled", which assumes a default for `envoy.prometheus.enabled` that the evidence never states. I corrected the statement and set severity to medium.

correction.statement: In Cilium 1.16.0 the deprecated Helm values `proxy.prometheus.enabled` and `proxy.prometheus.port` were removed. Anything set under them is no longer honoured; use `envoy.prometheus.enabled` and `envoy.prometheus.port` instead.

consequence.statement: Values set under `proxy.prometheus.enabled` and `proxy.prometheus.port` are no longer honoured after the upgrade because the options have been removed; the equivalent settings must be provided via `envoy.prometheus.enabled` and `envoy.prometheus.port`.
consequence.remediation: Move any `proxy.prometheus.enabled` and `proxy.prometheus.port` settings in your Helm values to `envoy.prometheus.enabled` and `envoy.prometheus.port` when upgrading to 1.16.0.
